description: Finds UK Parliament bills whose title matches a keyword, newest-updated first so current bills come before old ones, with each bill's ID, type, current stage and house, whether it became an Act, and a link to its Parliament page. For journalists, landlords, campaigners and students asking "is there a bill about X". Source: UK Parliament Bills API, which covers recent parliamentary sessions; older bills may be missing. It matches bill titles only, not bill text, and does not cover Scottish, Welsh or Northern Ireland legislatures. (cost: 1 credit)

q.description: string, required, word or phrase in the bill title, e.g. renters

skip.description: integer, optional, matches to skip for paging (results are newest-updated first), 0-100000, default 0

take.description: integer, optional, results to return 1-100, default 10

name: bill_search
